contentMap.productCategory: AI Image Generation and AI Video Generation
contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals seeking high-quality visual content creation, including creative directors, video producers, and art directors

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: AI Image Generation
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description: Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs. The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Capabilities of Seedream 4.5 by ByteDance
features.description: From accurate text rendering to consistent image editing and multi-image composition, Seedream 4.5 powers high-quality, professional visual creation with superior precision and control.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: AI Video Generation
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description: Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together. Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro
features.description: Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

testimonials.quote: Seedance’s ability to generate synchronized audio and video is incredibly powerful for storytelling and branded content.
testimonials.author: Vihaan Pandey

testimonials.quote: The multimodal editing capabilities in Seedream make it easy to refine images with precision.
testimonials.author: Anurag Malhotra

referenceMap.heroPattern: Full-width top hero with logo lockup, large bold headline, short supporting paragraph, and a compact 3-item benefit list using icon bullets; text-first composition with no visible hero media in the reference.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Single dominant hero followed by a lead-capture form block; limited long-form sectional storytelling in the provided markup, with content stacked vertically in a straightforward conversion funnel.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Simple form card treatment with enclosed container and clear heading; no evidence of glassmorphism, elevated promo cards, or rich media cards in the provided snippet.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary conversion is form-led rather than button-led; if buttons are used, they should be singular and high-emphasis, with one primary action per section and minimal competing CTAs.
referenceMap.footerMode: Not visible in the provided reference.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Minimal media usage in the visible content; logo placement in hero, otherwise text-forward layout with no prominent image/video panel shown.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Conversion landing-page pattern with a headline-led hero and a follow-up lead form; supports a modular section model where product blocks can be introduced as stacked single-column content sections.
referenceMap.formPattern: Prominent lead form card immediately after hero, with visible title, multiple hidden tracking fields, and vertical field stacking; optimized for lead capture and CRM routing rather than multi-step checkout.
referenceMap.animationStyle: No explicit animation pattern is detectable from the provided HTML; any motion appears absent or implemented externally.
designNotes: Use a restrained enterprise SaaS aesthetic with strong hierarchy and minimal distraction.
Prioritize a large headline, short subcopy, and concise benefit bullets above the fold.
Place a conversion form early in the page to support high-intent lead capture.
Keep visual emphasis on typography and spacing rather than illustration-heavy storytelling.
Maintain modular single-column sections for easy scanning and enterprise trust.

personality.buyer: Creative directors, video producers, art directors, and enterprise teams producing premium visual content
personality.emotion: Precision, creative control, and cinematic confidence
personality.reasoning: This product is clearly in the AI generative category, but the recent pattern for AI pages must be avoided. I am shifting away from the previously used cinematic-ai and operational-dashboard patterns into an editorial-b2b direction with a warmer brand-led identity. The brand palette already includes orange, white, and charcoal, so the page should feel premium, structured, and creative without defaulting to purple gradients. Because the product spans image and video generation with professional control, the visual language should balance editorial elegance with modular, interactive feature presentation.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The headline is long and needs a reduced hero size to stay elegant and avoid wrapping into an aggressive block. 40px keeps it premium and readable while preserving hierarchy.

colours.colourReason: The brand provides a vivid orange primary, which must drive the hero background and primary CTA. White and light grey support a clean editorial structure, while charcoal keeps the page grounded and professional. No extra palette is introduced beyond the provided brand colours.

layout.heroBackground: Solid brand-orange full-width hero with strong editorial typography, stacked supporting chips, and a high-contrast CTA cluster
layout.heroReason: Recent AI landing pages used split-left layouts, so this page should feel distinctly different. A centered hero creates a confident, premium poster-like composition that suits a visual-generation product while making the brand color the hero focal point.
layout.featureReason: Tabbed features are fresh compared with prior spotlight-plus-grid and accordion patterns. This format is ideal for switching between Seedream and Seedance, giving the page an interactive product-demo feel while keeping dense technical content organized.
layout.darkSectionFor: A single contrast-rich band for the Seedance video generation story or proof section can use charcoal with orange highlights to create a premium interruption in the otherwise light editorial flow.

personality.imageryDirection: Use a large hero JPEG featuring a polished generative content workspace: mock cinematic frames, prompt chips, timeline controls, and layered output previews. Support sections should use PNG UI mockups, comparison panels, and abstract creative shells rather than generic stock art. Visuals should feel like a high-end creative studio product, not a consumer AI toy.
personality.designPersonality: An editorial, brand-led AI product page that feels like a premium creative suite: structured typography, confident orange hero, modular tabs, refined shadows, and interactive product storytelling. It should project control, quality, and production-grade intelligence rather than flashy futurism.

designIntent.audience: Professionals seeking high-quality visual content creation, including creative directors, video producers, and art directors
designIntent.primaryUserIntent: Evaluate ByteDance generative AI capabilities for premium image and video creation, then request a demo or quote

brandDirection.tone: Expert, premium, technically credible, and results-focused
brandDirection.visualStyle: Text-forward conversion landing page with a strong editorial hierarchy, clean modular sections, and minimal decorative clutter; use a dark, high-contrast hero with polished product storytelling

sectionPurpose.purpose: Establish the combined value proposition for AI image and video generation, communicate premium quality fast, and push users toward the primary action.
Present the image-generation capability as the first core solution, with feature depth that builds confidence in fidelity, editing, and composition.
Present the video-generation capability as the second core solution, emphasizing synchronized audio-video creation, cinematic control, and speed.
Support conversion with package-level pricing context and quote-based CTAs, especially for the video product.
Reinforce credibility through professional-use testimonials from creative roles and reduce purchase anxiety.

componentNeeds.notes: Use a bold headline, short subheadline, and supporting line with one primary CTA. No secondary CTA provided. Since no hero media is available, keep the layout centered or slightly editorial, with strong typographic contrast and a compact benefit row if space allows.

componentNeeds.variantHint: headline-led stacked section with feature cards or bullets
componentNeeds.notes: Seedream has six features, so plan a 3-column desktop grid that collapses to one column on mobile. Keep the section highly scannable and use concise feature cards with clean icons or structured bullet treatments.

componentNeeds.variantHint: headline-led stacked section with feature cards or bullets
componentNeeds.notes: Seedance also has six features. Match the Seedream layout for consistency, but visually differentiate with the video narrative and audio-visual synchronization emphasis.
Use separate product pricing cards. Preserve quote-led CTA treatment. Seedance pricing has a starting monthly price, while Seedream is quote-based. Avoid introducing checkout UI.
Use the three valid professional testimonials only. Ignore the malformed placeholder testimonial. Keep cards concise, role-led, and credibility-first.

layoutStrategy.hero: Use a strong dark hero with white/light text, large headline, compact supporting copy, and a single high-emphasis CTA. Since the page is single-product but contains two product families, the hero should unify them as a premium generative suite rather than splitting attention immediately.
layoutStrategy.features: Use a modular stacked flow: Seedream first, then Seedance. Each product section should follow a headline, short description, and a 3-column feature grid on desktop. Keep visual rhythm consistent across both sections to reduce cognitive load.
layoutStrategy.proof: Use testimonials after pricing to support credibility with creative roles. If additional trust elements are needed, use them as lightweight text callouts rather than inventing badges or customer counts.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Present pricing in clear product-specific cards with strong visual hierarchy, but keep the section restrained and quote-oriented. Highlight the starting price for Seedance and position Seedream as request-based.
layoutStrategy.form: No form section should be designed because includeForm is false. Conversion should rely on CTA buttons that route to demo or quote actions.

designIntent.tokenProfileHint: Use a premium technical palette aligned to trust-authority with dark hero treatment, white section backgrounds, subtle gray dividers, and a restrained accent color for CTAs and emphasis. Typography should feel modern and precise, with strong hierarchy and ample spacing.
designIntent.figmaReadySummary: Design this as a premium, text-led B2B generative AI landing page with a strong dark hero, two clearly differentiated product feature sections, a quote-oriented pricing block, and professional testimonials. Keep the flow linear and conversion-focused, use 3-column feature grids on desktop, maintain consistent card treatment across sections, and avoid adding any form or unsupported trust modules.

sections.variantHint: centered text-first hero on brand-colored background with compact benefit list and single primary CTA
sections.contentSource: contentMap.hero + referenceMap.heroPattern + design memory hero rules
sections.notes: Use a dark brand-led hero treatment with white text. Include headline, subheadline, supporting line, and a compact 3-item benefit list using icon bullets. No visible media panel. Primary CTA should be the only strong button. Secondary CTA remains present per schema but can be an outline/low-emphasis placeholder if no explicit copy exists.

sections.variantHint: section header plus 3-column feature grid, white cards, one intro card and five capability cards
sections.notes: Present Seedream 4.5 as a dedicated product section. Use a section intro with label, headline, and description, followed by a 3-column grid of feature cards. Keep the first feature as a lead card with broader summary copy, then continue with individual capability cards. Include the section CTA as a small high-emphasis button aligned beneath the intro or above the grid.

sections.variantHint: section header plus 3-column feature grid, white cards, no CTA in section header unless adapted from surrounding funnel
sections.notes: Present Seedance 1.5 Pro as a second dedicated product section. Use a strong section header and a 3-column grid for the capabilities. Since no explicit CTA is provided, do not invent a new promotional CTA; keep the section informational and conversion-supportive. Maintain card consistency with Seedream section for system coherence.

sections.variantHint: two centered pricing cards in a 2-column layout, quote-focused, with checklist includes and clear CTA
sections.notes: Use the pricing section because pricing content is explicitly provided. Treat both items as quote cards, not self-serve checkout plans. The Seedance card includes a starting price and should visually prioritize that price; the Seedream card remains quote-led. Avoid adding fake discounts or EMI since those fields are not supplied. Keep both cards aligned and equal height if possible.

sections.variantHint: 3-column testimonial cards with star rating treatment and italicized quotes
sections.notes: Use the provided testimonial quotes and authors. Ignore the malformed fourth testimonial item with quote 'T' because it is not usable content. Use the section headline from extras: 'What Professionals Say About Seedream and Seedance?' if needed, but correct spelling to match product names. Cards should be white with a colored left border and include a visible gold star row.

sections.variantHint: single-column hero with text only, centered alignment, stacked CTAs if secondary is used
sections.notes: On mobile, keep the hero text-only and stacked. Ensure the headline reflows cleanly at the 16+ word sizing rule. Primary CTA should be full-width. If a secondary CTA is retained for schema consistency, stack it below the primary CTA with lower emphasis.

sections.variantHint: single-column feature cards with section intro and full-width CTA
sections.notes: Convert the feature grid to a single-column stack. Keep the section intro first, then the feature cards in semantic order. Preserve one CTA for the section and make it full-width. Card density should stay readable without truncation.

sections.variantHint: single-column feature cards with consistent spacing and no CTA
sections.notes: Stack all Seedance capability cards vertically. Keep the section concise and avoid adding extra UI elements not present in content. The section should mirror desktop structure while respecting mobile scrolling ergonomics.

sections.variantHint: stacked quote cards with full-width CTA buttons and simplified reading order
sections.notes: Stack pricing cards vertically on mobile. Preserve the card hierarchy and keep CTA buttons full-width. Do not add discount or EMI UI since those fields do not exist. The plan cards should remain quote-oriented rather than checkout-oriented.

sections.variantHint: single-column testimonial stack with gold star row and compact author details
sections.notes: Render testimonials as a vertical stack for mobile readability. Exclude the invalid fourth entry. Keep star rating visible, quote italicized, and author name bold. If space is tight, truncate nothing; instead allow cards to expand vertically.

figmaExecutionNotes: Use a marketing token profile with Sora for headings and Inter for body text, matching the Techjockey default marketing setup.
Keep the hero brand-led and text-first with no media panel, following the reference pattern.
Maintain a strict vertical funnel order: hero, Seedream features, Seedance features, pricing, testimonials.
Build Seedream and Seedance as two separate product feature modules with shared card primitives for consistency.
Use 3-column desktop feature grids and single-column mobile stacks.
Do not invent trust badges, news, footer, form fields, or why-techjockey blocks because the source content does not support them.
Exclude the malformed testimonial entry with quote 'T' from the final layout.
Keep pricing as quote-led cards and avoid unsupported discount, EMI, or strikethrough price treatments.
